as_told.title: Armstrong overheard saying grays warned not to return

plain: The astronaut Neil Armstrong is said to have told people in Washington DC, sometime in the 1970s, that "we were told not to come back to the moon." Michels repeats this as one of several "apocryphal stories" about Armstrong, without saying who heard it. A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells it a little differently: he says Armstrong was overheard saying it at a party, and that the warning came from the grays, the small grey beings of many alien accounts. If true, it would mean the moon landings were cut short by someone other than us.
